reason: V2 and subsequent causal-feature/RBF development screens did not meet calibration criteria
development_data: All original SECOM rows are exposed development data. Fit classifiers on the original training plus calibration rows; use the former 317-row test partition for development selection/calibration only.
candidates: Initial fixed 19 specifications reached 7/17 development recall. Follow-up: 40 logistic candidates, features 3/5/8/12/15/20/40/60 and C 0.0001/0.001/0.003/0.03/0.3. These are development searches, not repeated confirmation tests.
selection: On development validation, maximize runtime-guarded recall subject to the fixed false-alert budget; break ties by fewer false alerts, then higher average precision
confirmation: A separately supplied, nonoverlapping, later dataset with the same SECOM process and feature/label definitions is required. The supplied Zenodo macromilling dataset is incompatible; see macromilling-compatibility.md. No confirmation evaluation has run.
interpretation: Any passing result on original SECOM is development evidence, not final acceptance
